Kernel dereferences them on device causing invalid access. Fix by passing stride/shape values directly as kernel arguments (or via device memory), eliminating invalid device pointer dereference.

The launcher in custom_ops.cu passes these pointers unchanged to kernel, no device-side copy or scalar replacement.
